neighbours.label: a verb or participle of examining, regarding or limiting something (surveyed, investigating, viewing, overlook, doubt, modified, constrained, limited), firing on the verb itself; plain physical-action verbs in the same frames stay quiet
fire: Nearly half of the farmers surveyed reported a poor harvest.
Federal agents are investigating the fire at the warehouse.
Those viewing the old mayor kindly tend to be older voters.
Her balcony overlooks the harbor and the old lighthouse.
Few scholars now doubt the date of the manuscript.
Later copies of the map were modified by the printers.
Our budget was constrained by the cost of the new engine.
Entry to the small museum is limited to twenty guests.
quiet: Nearly half of the farmers nearby reported a poor harvest.
Federal agents are carrying the boxes from the warehouse.
Those feeding the old horses daily tend to be older farmers.
Her balcony sits above the harbor and the old lighthouse.
Few scholars now sell the pages of the manuscript.
Later copies of the map were printed on thick paper.
Our truck was loaded with the parts of the new engine.
Entry to the small museum is free for twenty guests.
